projects.name: Aksara Lontara Recognition
projects.description: Aksara Lontara Character Recognition is an intelligent web application engineered to bridge ancient cultural heritage with modern artificial intelligence. The platform provides an interactive, digital canvas where users can hand-draw traditional Aksara Lontara characters—the historic script of South Sulawesi, Indonesia—and receive instant, real-time machine learning transliterations into the Latin alphabet.

projects.name: DengarTulis App (AI-Powered Transcription)
projects.description: DengarTulis — a full-stack web app that transforms audio & video into accurate transcripts and AI-generated summaries, all in one seamless workflow.

projects.name: AI Update Hub
projects.description: AI-Update-Hub, a full-stack web application that aggregates and analyzes AI-related news from multiple sources — all in one place.

projects.name: AI Split Bills
projects.description: AI Split Bill is an AI-powered web application that extracts receipt data automatically and helps users split items, taxes, and service fees proportionally, fast and transparently.

projects.name: Eatitude.id
projects.description:
Eatitude.id – a personal healthy eating companion platform. ✨ Powered by AI, guided by Nutritionists. ✨

Eatitude.id was born from a simple yet urgent challenge: despite growing health awareness, many people still struggle to maintain consistent and balanced nutrition in their daily lives. With AI and expert guidance, our mission is to turn healthy eating into something personal, practical, and sustainable.

Eatitude.id is designed to make healthy eating personal, practical, and sustainable, through 5 key features:
✅ Personalized Nutrition Planner – AI-generated daily nutrition plans based on health profile, goals, and food preferences.
✅ Smart Meal Reminders – Keeps you on track with meal schedules and balanced menu suggestions.
✅ Nutri Scanner – Instantly scan food or nutrition labels to know calories and nutrients with AI-powered Computer Vision.
✅ Progress Tracking – Visualizes your daily nutrition intake, hydration, and progress toward health goals.
✅ Direct Nutritionist Consultation – Access expert guidance, tips, and live consultation with certified nutritionists.

projects.name: Galaxy Aksara
projects.description: Galaxy Aksara is a digital platform to learn Indonesian local scripts (aksara) in a fun and interactive way. Explore features like interactive learning, script writing tools, aksara translation, and curated content on local literature and culture — all in one place.

projects.name: Galaxy ALPR (Automatic License Plate Recognition)
projects.description: Galaxy ALPR — an automatic license plate recognition system that detects vehicles, reads plates, and provides useful metadata for further analysis and decision-making.

projects.name: AI Chatbot - VectorRAG
projects.description:
This project features a personalized AI chatbot built using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) on FlowiseAI, integrating OpenAI, Pinecone, and SQLite. By combining data retrieval from a custom knowledge base with AI-powered text generation, the chatbot delivers context-aware, accurate, and personalized responses. The system retrieves relevant information from Pinecone based on the meaning of user queries, while OpenAI's GPT model generates human-like responses, enhancing conversational quality. Additionally, SQLite stores user data and past interactions, ensuring a more personalized experience.

This solution improves chatbot performance by leveraging real-time data retrieval, providing a scalable and highly relevant response system that adapts to each user’s unique needs.

projects.name: Custom Object Detection
projects.description: The Custom Object Detection App is a powerful tool built with YOLOWorld technology, designed for precise and customizable object detection in both images and videos through a prompt-based approach. The app allows users to define custom object classes using simple prompts, upload media files, and adjust key detection parameters such as confidence and IoU thresholds, ensuring accurate and tailored detection results.

projects.name: Product Recognition
projects.description:
Product Recognition App, a smart solution that identifies and extracts detailed product information from images. This tool simplifies workflows by providing insights such as product name, brand, size, and packaging—perfect for businesses aiming to enhance efficiency and accuracy in product analysis and inventory management.

Built with cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence, this app integrates advanced Object Detection, Image Classification, and Optical Character Recognition (OCR) for precise and reliable product recognition.

projects.name: Hybrid Search Engine
projects.description: Movie Search Engine App, a Streamlit-based application that allows users to search for movies using three different search methodologies: Keyword Search, Vector Search, and Hybrid Search. The project leverages MongoDB, Hugging Face embeddings, and Streamlit for an interactive user interface.

projects.name: PPE Inspector
projects.description:
PPE Inspector is An artificial intelligence-based program for detecting Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) usage.
- Developed using the YOLOv8 algorithm and trained it on a dataset comprising 10,000 images.
- Achieved an impressive accuracy performance of 88% in detecting Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) usage, contributing to enhanced workplace safety. 
- Deployed and hosted on Streamlit Cloud, facilitating seamless accessibility and utilization for end-users.

projects.name: Personalized English Learning
projects.description: Personalized English Learning is a web-based English language learning application that utilizes AI models to interact with users. The application is designed to be interactive, adaptive, and personalizing the English learning process according to the user's abilities.
